methodology: Real authenticated storefront HTML/data; browser-only replacement of theme bootstrap and generated JS/CSS chunks from isolated matching Golfballs builds. Identical instrumentation wraps public revive() synchronously; no source/deployment change. Mobile 412x823, 4x CPU, network unthrottled, cold browser cache per navigation; alternating variants across three rounds. LCP/CLS observed over a fixed 5s post-DCL window, not field metrics. Interaction checks run after timing collection.
